messages:
maya: ran a focused nsys + perfetto capture on the nightly e2e workload. seeing a new hotspot: kv_cache write bursts during attention rollout, correlates with flash-attn fused kernel switching. big tail on p99s. :worried:
alejandro: link? can you drop perfetto and nsys snippets? :eyes:
maya: perfetto: https://perfetto.dev/trace/XXXXX (private). nsys snippet below, trimmed:
```
GPU: 8 SMs busy
2.9ms  flash_attn_fused_kernel            78.4%   (sustained when seq>1024)
1.6ms  kv_cache_write_stage               41.2%   (serializes across warps)
0.7ms  kv_cache_commit_handler            19.6%   (atomic contention)
```
cheng: hmm kv_cache_write_stage at 1.6ms is suspicious. does the trace show frequent small writes or big batched writes?
maya: small, a lot of small 256B-ish writes after we fall back from prefix cache. distribution shifted because batching heuristic started grouping many short seq requests into bigger logical batches.
sam: any kernel names for the serializer? need exact strings for kernel selector rules.
maya: kernel is `kvcache_writer_v2` and `flash_attn_fused_kernel` switches variants: `flash_attn_v1` -> `flash_attn_v2_prefetch`. selector decided v2_prefetch when batch variance > 0.4.
alejandro: can you paste the selector decision log? there should be a one-line csv in the trace.
maya: pasted log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T21:03:12Z selector: batch_size=32 mean_seq=520 var=0.47 choose=flash_v2_prefetch
2026-03-17T21:03:12Z request: kv_write_mode=split-small
2026-03-17T21:03:12Z trace_id=0x7f3a kvcache_writer_v2 launches=154
```
cheng: sounds like write mode 'split-small' is causing many tiny writes. split-small used when mean_seq>256 but variance>0.4. maybe change threshold to 0.55 or add a write-coalescing window.
perf-bot: perf regression detected: p99 latency +14% vs baseline (2026-03-16). commit range: rfd/selector-heuristics.
alejandro: can we repro locally with a targeted microtrace? maya, can you spin a smaller nsys with 8 warmup iterations and then a 200-step run hitting the same batch dist?
maya: on it, starting capture now. command: `nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt --output=kv-slice-2965432109 python run_infer.py --batch-config slice-sampler.json`
sam: also capture NVTX around kvcache write and add `--env KVCACHE_COALESCE_MS=3` to test coalescing.
maya: ran capture and compared flamegraphs. observation: when coalesce disabled, kvcache_writer_v2 spawns 6k kernels per minute. with 3ms coalesce, kernels drop to 1.2k and p99 drops ~9%.
alejandro: nice. can you attach the minimal perfetto view (screenshots would be ideal) and the nvprof kernel timeline tex?
maya: attached inline snippets only here, full trace uploaded to infra bucket. perfetto flame: `kv_write bursts` align with `flash_v2_prefetch` variant windows.
cheng: suggestion: update selector to prefer `flash_v1` when var>0.35 and mean_seq between 320-768, but also enable local coalescing by default for split-small writes. tests?
alejandro: make a small change PR: selector delta + coalesce default 2ms, and add unit test with synthetic batch sampler to assert kernel launches < threshold. I'll own the PR.
maya: thanks — one more note: memory profiler shows elevated L2 traffic during those bursts; coalescing reduces L2 thrash by ~22%.
sam: good metric to include in PR. can you include the nsys CLI + perfetto links and the before/after p99 numbers?
maya: will do. starting the A/B on canary env now, will post results in this thread.
perf-bot: canary run started: canary-42 (50 qps).
maya: canary p99 after patch: -10% (back to baseline), kv_write kernel launches down 78%, L2 traffic -20%.
ench: awesome. closing triage — follow-up: add an integration eval to catch this distribution shift in nightly perf tests.
alejandro: filed RFC ticket for eval harness: INF-789. assign to eng-runtime perf. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone. will link PR and ticket when ready.
